composition: Finibus Terrae lighthouse at Italy’s heel tip above the Ionian–Adriatic meeting · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera looks across the rocky headland at Italy's heel tip at midday, the tall white lighthouse standing at the center of the frame. A small stone chapel keeps it company at the left, footpaths threading the low scrub between them, while the rocky cliff drops to the sea at the right. The modelled 23 September 2026, 11:59 sun is bright and high, the blue Ionian and Adriatic waters meeting on the horizon under a nearly cloudless sky.
